description: This file defines the 'MethodResultColumn' class, a custom implementation of the 'IColumn' interface used to extract and format method invocation results within the BenchmarkDotNet framework. It includes functionality to invoke benchmark workload methods via reflection and to retrieve their results for reporting purposes.

classes.name: MethodResultColumn
classes.description: A class implementing 'IColumn' to provide custom benchmarking result columns that invoke and retrieve method results via reflection.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Overloaded methods to retrieve the formatted value of the benchmark method result, with or without style parameter.

methods.name: CallMethod
methods.description: Invokes the workload method of a benchmark case via reflection, handling setup and cleanup calls, and returns the result or null if invocation fails.

methods.name: IsDefault
methods.description: Indicates whether this column has a default value; always returns false.

methods.name: IsAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the column is applicable based on available reports in the summary.
